title: Annotated Code of Maryland, Labor and Employment Article, Title 3, Subtitle 13 - Earned Sick and Safe Leave (Maryland Healthy Working Families Act)
verified_how: Fetched the section page for Article - Labor and Employment, § 3-1301: live text opening 'In this subtitle the following words have the meanings indicated', defining 'earned sick and safe leave', 'employee' with six exclusions, 'employer', 'family member' across ten categories, plus domestic violence, sexual assault and stalking. Served with enactments=false; mgaleg prints no as-at date or short title on the section page.
notes: The register does not print the popular name; 'Maryland Healthy Working Families Act' is the short title given by the enacting session law, not by the code page - a human should confirm the short title against the session law if it matters. SECOND STATUTE TO WATCH: the Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program sits in the same article at Title 8.3 (Md. Code, Lab. & Empl. § 8.3-101 et seq.), verified as live on the register (§8.3-101 opens 'In this title the following words have the meanings indicated' and defines 'Program' as 'the Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program established under § 8.3-301'). HUMAN CHECK: its contribution and benefit start dates have been deferred more than once by amending legislation, and mgaleg prints no effective-date note, so the commencement position must be checked before treating Title 8.3 as operative. Maryland has no statutory entitlement to paid public holidays in private employment.
